detail: No recipe regenerates these files: tools/harness_check.py --write-stubs rewrites only the derived-stub blocks, and test-stubs reports 0 findings. Five mechanisms, each traced from the tree and each confirmed by the next failure in a scratch overlay: (1) 24281d120 (10-04, window-read: the funded window path) added CLASS to fnn-owner-cold-poll (host/native/owner.lisp:6858) and web-host.lisp:668 passes :reader; the mock's (defun fnn-owner-cold-poll (service read first since)) at tests/native_web_reactor_raw-mock.lisp:138 and the lambda at tests/native_web_article_stream_raw.lisp:115 take 4, 'invalid number of arguments: 5'. (2) 65b9a3077 (10-07) made a failed web cleanup end the process through fnn-owner-install-or-end (web-host.lisp:150); the mock defines neither it nor fnn-quantum-mux-finish, which the cleanup thunk calls, so a cleanup failure the old handler swallowed silently now aborts the mock. (3) ef2747aae (10-07, def-loop: web-render) made fn-wr-pct-encode a def-loop (books/web-render.lisp:142); page_cursor's load-page-forms evaluates only defun/defconst and never asserts a named form was found, so it is skipped and fn-wr-piece fails undefined. (4) tests/raw_def_loop.lisp lacks assoc-eq, which fn-dl-psubst needs for a def-loop whose body binds with let (its existing users never reach it). (5) 130529298 (10-07, WIP, the ARTICLE render reads a span at a time) calls fn-arena-get-span (books/article-stream.lisp:598); the producer's arena model defines fn-arena-get, -payload-len and -count only. With all five supplied in an overlay the four files pass (reactor mock, page cursor and private reply, article stream, the shared producer). Also: harness_check raw-arity reports 0 findings although (1) is a raw arity mismatch between a mock's definition and a call in the host file it loads (a lint gap), and harness_check.py:1985 says seven web harnesses load the reactor mock where one does (page_cursor). No Python native runs these files; scenarios SCN-1099, 1105, 1108, 1113 (status specified) cite them. Repair at the mechanism: mocks take the current host signatures, page_cursor loads through raw_def_loop and refuses a missing named form, raw_def_loop gains assoc-eq, the producer's arena model gains the span read; then a native runs them (a tests/test_native_web_raw.py over the four) so drift turns a gate red.
